Prevention slice DELIVERED via child bug 8bef-1558-b3ef-4b19 (cleverish-unwitty-xanclomys) — Gerrit change 2386 MERGED to main (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1), commit carries rebar-ticket trailer.

What landed: a per-ticket re-enrichment DEBOUNCE on the enrichment self-heal path (enrich_drain._stale_digest_ids skips a present-stale ticket whose latest DONE_ENRICH is within overlap_reenrich_debounce_min, default 24h; env REBAR_LLM_OVERLAP_REENRICH_DEBOUNCE_MIN; 0 disables). Root cause proven: the self-heal scan re-enqueued every present-stale ticket on every drain with no idempotence/cap, so ordinary comment/edit/reconcile churn re-fired a full enrichment quartet each drain (~15x/ticket, ~81K events = bulk of the ~10x commit-rate surge since 2026-08-23); be8a0c0 (bug 8185) had removed the only retention bound. The fix deletes NO event, so it fully honors this epic's merge-safe / no-history-deletion invariant.

SCOPE NOTE (why the epic stays `idea`, not closed): this delivers only the "PREVENT future growth" concern. This epic's broader ACs — merge-safe on-disk compaction of committed history, growth benchmarks, a migration path, and ongoing growth-rate monitoring — are NOT addressed by a debounce and remain open. Git-history reclamation (shrinking the existing pack) is explicitly out of scope here and owned by sibling 536b. Recommend keeping this epic open to track the remaining retention/compaction design; the acute fan-out bleed is now stopped.
